subject: cr-info-dy
title: CR.INFO.DY.------C.INFO.
description: Diagram in WM-28, on the page where Braxton argues that 'the essence alignment of world creativity is based on the synthesis of concept and spiritualism.' CR-INFO-DY (a diagram-only compound — likely 'creative information dynamics' — see also similar-form CR-INFO-DY in glossary as 'circular information dynamics'; here read in the WM-28 context as how creative information moves) is *crossed* with C-INFO (composite information). Two argumentative arcs flow from the subject. Through SOC-RT (social reality) → CULT-INFO-F (culture information focus) → INDIV-TD (individual tendencies), with a sub-branch from CULT-INFO-F into LANG-DY (language dynamics) → T-C-IMP (time continuum implications): this arc traces how creative information moves from social reality into individual tendencies *only via* the language-dynamics filter, with implications across the time continuum. Through C-INFO into ASP-ES (aspect essence), MT-INFO (multi-information), and (r)INDIV-DY-RT (the reality of individual dynamic reality) — which dashed-links to (r)INTR (interpretation) and solid-links to LK-IMP (linkage implications): this arc traces how composite information saturates the individual at the level of interpretive linkage. The crossing's argument: world creativity's information-dynamics cannot be read as social transmission alone, nor as individual reception alone — it requires the synthesis of both arcs, the very synthesis western analytical practice (per Braxton on this page) routinely fails to perform.
